DML.SELECT: SELECT incident_alarm_condition_id as "id", incident_type_id as "incidentTypeId", stretch_id as "stretchId", auto as "auto", road_impact_id as "roadImpactId", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.ims_incident_alarm_conditions WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.ims_incident_alarm_conditions (incident_alarm_condition_id, incident_type_id, stretch_id, auto, road_impact_id, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:id=getNextId{'conf.ims_incident_alarm_conditions'$'incident_alarm_condition_id'}, :incidentTypeId, :stretchId, :auto, :roadImpactId, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE conf.ims_incident_alarm_conditions SET incident_type_id = :incidentTypeId, stretch_id = :stretchId, auto = :auto, road_impact_id = :roadImpactId, enabled = :enabled, visible = :visible, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE incident_alarm_condition_id = :id
